fixes.problem: Finite extreme FP32 values can overflow mean reductions. A NaN text score was ignored by partition max, or an infinite denominator reduced the score to zero, allowing replay.
fixes.resolution: Reject nonfinite delta/scale reductions and nonfinite partition scores before aggregation.
fixes.scope: Numerical safety boundary; no claim that normal BF16 workflow images were corrupted.

fixes.problem: An external block-patch fallback could hide invalid condition identity or sigma and retain history after an untrusted call.
fixes.resolution: Validate identity and sigma independently of the primary fallback reason; clear all history when either is untrusted.
fixes.scope: Confirmed with a real miniature native MOSS block replacement; standard complete-identity CFG behavior remains covered.

fixes.problem: Streams without stored tensor history could bypass the existing eight-stream limit. Retained tensor history was already bounded.
fixes.resolution: Apply the eight-stream LRU limit at stream insertion and retain the separate byte budget on store.
fixes.scope: Low-impact metadata bound; not a claim of a demonstrated large tensor leak.

tests.scope: CPU suite including real miniature native MOSS; no model weights required

image_validation.scope: Saved Base/SFT canvas and timing evidence remains tied to 0.1.0. This release adds no new large-model quality or speed measurement.
